title: Organization reference
description: An organization, as either a plain name string or a structured Organization object that can carry a canonical organization IRI and an external one (ROR, Wikidata).

id.description: Canonical BattINFO organization IRI linking this party to its organization record.

same_as.description: External identifier IRI for this organization (e.g. ROR or Wikidata).

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.
